610:             Shapelet-Transform of the provided time series.
611:         """
612:         check_is_fitted(self, '_X_fit_dims')
613:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
614:         X = self._preprocess_series(X)
615:         X = check_dims(X, X_fit_dims=self._X_fit_dims,
616:                        check_n_features_only=True)
617:         self._check_series_length(X)
618: 
619:         pred = self.transformer_model_.predict(
620:             X,
621:             batch_size=self.batch_size, verbose=self.verbose
622:         )
623:         return pred.astype(float)
624: 
625:     def locate(self, X):
626:         """Compute shapelet match location for a set of time series.
627: 
628:         Parameters
629:         ----------
630:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
631:             Time series dataset.
632: 
633:         Returns
634:         -------
635:         array of shape=(n_ts, n_shapelets)
636:             Location of the shapelet matches for the provided time series.
637: 
638:         Examples
639:         --------
640:         >>> from tslearn.generators import random_walk_blobs
641:         >>> X = numpy.zeros((3, 10, 1))
642:         >>> X[0, 4:7, 0] = numpy.array([1, 2, 3])
643:         >>> y = [1, 0, 0]
644:         >>> # Data is all zeros except a motif 1-2-3 in the first time series
645:         >>> clf = LearningShapelets(n_shapelets_per_size={3: 1}, max_iter=1,
646:         ...                     verbose=0)
647:         >>> _ = clf.fit(X, y)
648:         >>> weights_shapelet = [
649:         ...     numpy.array([[[1], [2], [3]]])
650:         ... ]
651:         >>> clf.set_weights(weights_shapelet, layer_name="shapelets_0")
652:         >>> clf.locate(X)
653:         array([[4],
654:                [0],
655:                [0]])
656:         """
657:         check_is_fitted(self, '_X_fit_dims')
658:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
659:         X = self._preprocess_series(X)
660:         X = check_dims(X, X_fit_dims=self._X_fit_dims,
661:                        check_n_features_only=True)
662:         self._check_series_length(X)
663: 
664:         locations = self.locator_model_.predict(
665:             X,
666:             batch_size=self.batch_size, verbose=self.verbose
667:         )
668:         return locations.astype(int)
669: 
670:     def _check_series_length(self, X):
671:         """Ensures that time series in X matches the following requirements:
672: 
673:         - their length is greater than the size of the longest shapelet
674:         - their length is lower than the maximum allowed length,
675:         as set by max_size or deduced from fitted data.
676:         """
677:         self._min_sz_fit = min(_ts_size(Xi) for Xi in X)
678: 
679:         if self.n_shapelets_per_size is not None:
680:             max_sz_shp = max(self.n_shapelets_per_size.keys())
681:             if max_sz_shp > self._min_sz_fit:
682:                 raise ValueError("Sizes in X do not match maximum "
683:                                  "shapelet size: there is at least one "
684:                                  "series in X that is shorter than one of the "
685:                                  "shapelets. Shortest time series is of "
686:                                  "length {} and longest shapelet is of length "
687:                                  "{}".format(self._min_sz_fit, max_sz_shp))
688: 
689:         max_size = self.max_size
690:         if max_size is None:
691:             max_size = self._X_fit_dims[1] if hasattr(self, '_X_fit_dims') else X.shape[1]
692: 
693:         if X.shape[1] > max_size:
694:             raise ValueError("Sizes in X do not match maximum allowed "
695:                              "size as set by max_size or "
696:                              "computed when fit. "
697:                              "Longest time series is of "
698:                              "length {} and maximum allowed size is "
699:                              "{}".format(X.shape[1], max_size))
700: 
701:     def _preprocess_series(self, X):
702:         """Scale if needed, pad with nans if needed."""
703:         if self.scale:
704:             X = TimeSeriesScalerMinMax().fit_transform(X)
705:         else:
706:             X = to_time_series_dataset(X)
707: 
708:         max_size = self.max_size
709:         if max_size is None:
710:             max_size = self._X_fit_dims[1] if hasattr(self, '_X_fit_dims') else X.shape[1]
711: 
712:         if max_size > X.shape[1]:
713:             X_ = numpy.zeros((X.shape[0], max_size, X.shape[2]))
714:             X_[:, :X.shape[1]] = X
715:             X_[:, X.shape[1]:] = numpy.nan
716:             return X_
717:         else:
718:             return X
719: 
720:     def _preprocess_labels(self, y):
721:         self.classes_ = unique_labels(y)
722:         n_labels = len(self.classes_)
723:         if n_labels == 1:
724:             raise ValueError("Classifier can't train when only one class "
725:                              "is present.")
726:         if self.classes_.dtype in [numpy.int32, numpy.int64]:
727:             label_to_ind_ = {int(lab): ind
728:                                   for ind, lab in enumerate(self.classes_)}
729:         else:
730:             label_to_ind_ = {lab: ind
731:                                   for ind, lab in enumerate(self.classes_)}
732:         y_ind = numpy.array(
733:             [label_to_ind_[lab] for lab in y]
734:         )
735:         y_ = to_categorical(y_ind)
736:         if n_labels == 2:
737:             y_ = y_[:, 1:]  # Keep only indicator of positive class
738:         return y_
739: 
740:     def _build_auxiliary_models(self):
741:         check_is_fitted(self, 'model_')
742: 
743:         inputs = self.model_.inputs
744:         concatenated_features = self.model_.get_layer("classification").input
745: 
746:         self.transformer_model_ = Model(inputs=inputs,
747:                                         outputs=concatenated_features)
748:         self.transformer_model_.compile(loss="mean_squared_error",
749:                                         optimizer=self.optimizer)
750: 
751:         min_pool_inputs = [self.model_.get_layer("min_pooling_%d" % i).input[0]
752:                            for i in range(self._n_shapelet_sizes)]
753:         pool_layers_locations = [
754:             GlobalArgminPooling1D(name="argmin_pooling_%d" % i)(pool_input)
755:             for i, pool_input in enumerate(min_pool_inputs)
756:         ]
757:         if self._n_shapelet_sizes > 1:
758:             concatenated_locations = concatenate(pool_layers_locations)
759:         else:
760:             concatenated_locations = pool_layers_locations[0]
761: 
762:         self.locator_model_ = Model(inputs=inputs,
763:                                     outputs=concatenated_locations)
764:         self.locator_model_.compile(loss="mean_squared_error",
765:                                     optimizer=self.optimizer)
